notes.title: Royal Navy DLC now available + Patch 1.4 of Final Theory
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33566314/9b843c44f164d69476a3d7e2d04d4eb6cbacec5b.jpg[/img]
The Royal Navy DLC is now available, along with patch 1.4 of Final Theory.

[b]Final Theory - Patch 1.4[/b]
[list]
[*] New map ability: Propaganda Campaign
Broadcast propaganda to convince neutral or enemy regions to join your fight against the Empire. Take advantage of failed attempts that can lead to incursion opportunities deep behind enemy lines.
[*] The core Imperial regions will now be guarded by the Royal Navy.
(This final battle event is available to all players.)
[*] Lower difficulties reworked to allow for a more casual experience.
[*] Game engine updated.
[*] Quality of life improvements and more.
[/list]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/894630/discussions/0/4576185279368583637/]See Full Patch Notes[/url]


[b]The Royal Navy DLC[/b]

The ships of the Royal Navy feature a mix of new abilities and weapons, gold alloy armor plating, particle beams, cluster bombs, long range missiles and more.
[list]
[*] 7 different ship classes to command + 1 deployable ship.
[*] 7 fleet-wide stackable ship bonuses.
[*] 8 ship tiers featuring weapons, abilities and skill points.
[*] 56 module upgrades to choose from.
[*] Play as, or against the Royal Navy.
[*] Supports the main game, Quick Battles and Custom Battles right out of the box.
(You don't have to unlock any achievements before you can use the navy.)
[*] Quick Battles and Custom Battles support PvP through Steam Remote Play Together.
[/list]
This release is the first DLC navy for Final Theory with still more to come. As always a huge thanks to all of our players. Your support and enthusiasm is what has allowed the continued development of the game. This navy has been a long time coming, and we know a lot of you have been waiting patiently for it's release. We're so delighted to say, the wait is over and it's time to take the Royal Navy for a spin.

Happy holidays, stay safe everyone and we thank all of you for your support.

-Monticube

notes.title: Patch 1.3 Celebration Discount - Quick and Custom Battles with PvP
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33566314/e8d297b61ed0c7efc0151bbbcabf0e017cfb04f3.png[/img]
With the release of Patch 1.3 and with summer just around the corner, we wanted to add a celebration discount to the game. Now you can pick up the game at an amazing price, or gift it to a friend so they can practice their battle skills.

Jump straight into the action with the new Quick Battles, or setup a Custom Battle with the exact ships, upgrades and adjustments you want to use. Deploy up to 15 ships each and battle against your friends by inviting them to join your game. Simply launch the game, click on a friend from your friends list and select Remote Play Together.

Learn more about [url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay]Steam Remote Play Together[/url]

[list]
[*] New game modes: Quick and Custom Battles.
[*] More player colors added.
[*] Achievements window added.
[*] AI updated and more.
[/list]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/894630/discussions/0/2283834583168329121/]See Full Patch Notes[/url]


Stay safe and have fun challenging your friends.

-Monticube

notes.title: Final Theory official release date September 21st.
notes.notes:
It's been a long journey and a daunting task at times but we're very happy to announce that the official release date will be September 21st. The US region price will be $14.99 but to celebrate our first ever release Final Theory will hit the digital shelves of Steam at a 10% launch discount during the first week of it's release. Remember to tell your friends so they too can snag a copy at the discounted price.

We wish you good luck Commanders.

-Monticube
